metadata.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su delivers keynote with big AI update for tech investors

content.text:
AMD (AMD) CEO Dr. Lisa Su takes the stage at the Advancing AI 2026 conference to outline the company's vision for the future of AI, introducing new chips and platforms to drive data center growth.
